ValidationRule.description: Use a Business Account partner, a positive points price, and complete the active reward description.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use a Business Account partner, a positive points price, and complete the active reward description.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(Points_Cost__c <= 0, Value_CZK__c < 0, Partner__r.IsPersonAccount, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Partner__r.Type, "Partner")), AND(Is_Active__c, ISBLANK(Description__c)))
